summary: Recorded the measured interpretation of the three-case experiment (CheckRun 0b99df9ed72e4cd2b653c5741e4eec3d, exit 0, tests_passed), which confirms and sharpens the precondition of the snapshot-boundary loop. Parsed indices: 10 (TrailingLogs=0) rejoin_observe with restores_early 704 / restores_late 715, partner_applied_index pinned at 4, partner_last_index 7, partner_store 5..7 and successor_store 0/0, with the timeline at indices 4–9 rising 104, 219, 333, 458, 583, 704 while the partner's applied-command count stayed at 1; index 21 (TrailingLogs=10) and index 32 (TrailingLogs=25) both restores 0 with partner applied and last index 24; indices 3 and 14/25 show the cause — after the snapshot at index 4 the successor's store was empty only in the TrailingLogs=0 case and 1..4 in the others, staying 1..24 after twenty post-snapshot entries. That matches compactLogsWithTrailing: with the log end equal to the snapshot index at snapshot time, 4 <= 10 and 4 <= 25 make it return without deleting, so only TrailingLogs=0 lets the deletion reach the boundary. Conclusion violated / defect_claim refuted for this investigation's generalisation (that a larger TrailingLogs merely delays the loop), while the underlying defect stays asserted on its narrower basis: both earlier asserted witnesses ran with TrailingLogs=0 and are unaffected, but the claim must be stated as requiring the leader's log end to be at least TrailingLogs ahead of the snapshot index when the snapshot is taken — so the practical trigger is a snapshot taken while the applied index lags the log end (a user-triggered snapshot during a write backlog, or a threshold-triggered snapshot under sustained load), not a routine periodic snapshot in a caught-up cluster with default TrailingLogs. The precondition Behavior is revised in place to revision 2 with the measured operands and the corrected reading, referenced from the interpretation via a KnowledgeUse; counterevidence (both nonzero cases converge, same effect as the earlier TrailingLogs=3 control) and limitations (no threshold bisection, snapshots only user-triggered at a quiet moment, in-process setup) are recorded. Structural validation returned valid=true.
